verdict.rationale: Tilled's docs cover pieces of the money-flow story — payouts and payout-speed visibility, merchant pricing templates (fee configuration), batch settlement/close, webhooks for event notifications, and a 'reporting console' — which together imply traceability from charge to payout, but there is no direct evidence of a unified ledger view showing balances by seller vs. platform fee accounts or penny-level reconciliation tooling. Missing for 10: explicit balance/ledger reporting UI, dedicated fee-account balance tracking, and reconciliation/audit-trail documentation tying charge→split→payout together.
